result.topic_en: A page of short problem statements: the motion of bodies on a frictionless horizontal plane joined by threads and pulled by a force, expanding a product of factors (1-x^k), the limit of the sum of totients divided by n^2, star polygons and the regular star polyhedra derived from them, and a system of cyclic linear equations.

items.english: Let bodies A, B, C etc. lie on a horizontal plane (which we conceive to be without friction), connected in any way by threads; let a force be applied to the thread at E along EF so that the point E is always drawn along this line; the motion of the bodies A, B, C is sought.

items.quote:

Lim: $\frac{\Sigma \text{ pr. ad } n \text{ infra } n}{nn}$
items.english: Find the limit of (sum of the numbers of integers below n prime to n) divided by n^2.

items.english: To investigate the regular polyhedra which derive their origin from polygons of this figure [a pentagram].
